marketing_description: The DeWALT DCF964B cordless high torque impact wrench delivers 1200 ft-lb fastening torque and 1750 ft-lb breakaway torque, powered by a 20‑V lithium‑ion battery and a brushless motor for efficient operation. It features a 3/4 in square drive, 0‑to‑1890 ipm impact rate, and 0‑to‑1200 RPM speed with four selectable modes via a trigger switch. The black/yellow housing includes an LED work light and precision wrench control to prevent over‑tightening and fastener run‑off.
